answer_1.quote: SpellingBee is a generative language model that predicts the character composition of a token given only its (uncontextualized) vector representation from the pretrained model's embeddings matrix.

answer_2.quote: We measure success on the test set using two metrics: exact match (EM), and character ngram overlap score using chrF.

answer_4.quote: We manually analyze 100 random tokens that SpellingBee spelled incorrectly with the lemma filter to understand the nature of the spelling mistakes.
